svg.title: Figure 5. Solving a redundant bar by superposition
svg.desc: A stepped bar fixed between two walls with a load P B at the step equals the same bar with the right wall removed, loaded by P B and heated, plus the bar loaded only by the unknown wall reaction R at its right end. The free elongations add: delta P plus delta T plus delta R equals zero for a fixed wall, or equals the gap g once it closes, where delta R equals minus R times the sum of the segment flexibilities L over E A.
